title: Yellow Spiced Kenyan Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and aromatic Kenyan dish featuring chicken skewers marinated in a blend of spices and grilled to perfection, served solo for a satisfying dinner
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, ghee, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the chopped birds-eye chillies to the bowl and stir to combine
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a side of steamed vegetables if desired
